name: Downtown Disney Splitsville Luxury Lanes: Fresh Salmon Nigiri, California Roll & Grilled Chicken Rice Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Splitsville Luxury Lanes (Downtown Disney District · Disneyland Resort)
whyItWorks: Splitsville actually has one of the best sushi bars and scratch kitchens in Downtown Disney: fresh Salmon Nigiri, plain California/Avocado Rolls, and a Grilled Chicken & White Rice bowl (ordered with mild teriyaki on the side, no broccoli/peppers).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the California Roll, Salmon Nigiri, or Grilled Chicken & White Rice Bowl (ask for plain grilled chicken and white rice only, no spicy volcano/sriracha mayo and no ponzu citrus sauce).
watchOuts: Skip Volcano Roll (spicy mayo) and any rolls with ponzu/lemon slices
